items.title: 61428_Red Callender oral history interview
items.q: Interviewer mentions 'Big Sid was the drummer' in the context of the group; Interviewee responds 'Uh-huh' and continues discussing other members (Frenchy, John Simmons) but does not describe a personal or professional relationship with Big Sid.

ctx.x: 1947. And it was right after this that Joe Glaser decided to puts Pops in front of a small group. So he got Jack Teagarden and Barney Bigard... I don't know whether Zutty was doing that at this time or not.
When I saw the group, it was two years later. Big Sid was the drummer.

Uh-huh. Anyhow, when it first got off the ground, they called me, and I had just finished doing the picture, you know, making some very nice bread. Because I was working independently, I had my own agent. So Frenchy, who was Pops'...
